epithet.en: Young heir of the Ingmar Farm, torn between love and land
epithet.da: Ung arving til Ingmargården, revet mellem kærlighed og jord

1.modern-en: Ingmar faces a moral crisis: Brita, the girl he loves, has been imprisoned for infanticide, and he must decide whether to stand by her. He travels to fetch her from prison, honoring the old Ingmar tradition of doing what is right even when it is hard.
1.modern-da: Ingmar står over for en moralsk krise: Brita, pigen han elsker, er fængslet for barnemord, og han må beslutte om han vil stå ved hende. Han rejser for at hente hende fra fængslet og følger den gamle Ingmar-tradition med at gøre det rigtige, selv når det er svært.

4.modern-en: As a boy, Ingmar is taken in by Storm after his father's death and grows up at the schoolmaster's side. He delivers a broken watch to a craftsman, a small errand that reveals his earnest, dutiful nature.
4.modern-da: Som dreng tages Ingmar ind af Storm efter sin fars død og vokser op hos skolemesteren. Han leverer et ødelagt ur til en håndværker, et lille ærinde der afslører hans oprigtige og pligtopfyldende natur.

6.modern-en: At the Wild Hunt dance, Ingmar is swept up in the revelry along with the other young people of the parish. Gertrude clings to him during the wild celebration, and a tender bond between them begins to form.
6.modern-da: Ved Vilde Jagt-dansen bliver Ingmar revet med i festligholderne sammen med de andre unge i sognet. Gertrude klamrer sig til ham under den vilde fest, og et ømtåleligt bånd begynder at knytte sig mellem dem.

7.modern-en: Ingmar resists the pull of Hellgum's revival movement, unwilling to abandon the old ways of the Ingmar farm. When three men attack Hellgum in the road, Ingmar steps in and saves him, demonstrating his innate sense of justice regardless of his own beliefs.
7.modern-da: Ingmar modstår trækket fra Hellgums vækkelsebevægelse og er uvillig til at opgive den gamle Ingmar-gårds traditioner. Da tre mænd overfalder Hellgum på vejen, griber Ingmar ind og redder ham og viser sin medfødte retfærdighedssans uanset egne overbevisninger.

8.modern-en: Wounded from the fight, Ingmar is nursed back to health. Gertrude sits by his bedside and finally confesses her love for him, and Ingmar, moved and surprised, begins to see her in a new light.
8.modern-da: Såret fra kampen plejes Ingmar tilbage til helbred. Gertrude sidder ved hans seng og bekender til sidst sin kærlighed til ham, og Ingmar, rørt og overrasket, begynder at se hende i et nyt lys.

11.modern-en: The engagement between Ingmar and Gertrude is announced, bringing hope for the future of the Ingmar farm. But Karin's announcement that the Hellgumists are called to Jerusalem casts a shadow over the celebration.
11.modern-da: Forlovelsen mellem Ingmar og Gertrude bekendtgøres og bringer håb for Ingmar-gårdens fremtid. Men Karins meddelelse om at Hellgumisterne er kaldet til Jerusalem kaster en skygge over festen.

12.modern-en: Ingmar and Gertrude spend time together during their engagement, drawing closer. Ingmar struggles internally as he watches Karin and the Hellgumists prepare to leave everything behind for Jerusalem.
12.modern-da: Ingmar og Gertrude tilbringer tid sammen under forlovelsestiden og nærmer sig hinanden. Ingmar kæmper indeni mens han ser Karin og Hellgumisterne forberede sig på at forlade alt for Jerusalems skyld.

13.modern-en: The Ingmar farm is put up for sale to fund the pilgrimage to Jerusalem. Ingmar watches helplessly as the ancestral property he has dreamed of reclaiming slips toward strangers' hands.
13.modern-da: Ingmar-gården sættes til salg for at finansiere pilgrimsrejsen til Jerusalem. Ingmar ser magtesløst til mens den forfædrenes ejendom han har drømt om at genvinde glider mod fremmede hænder.

15.modern-en: At the farm auction, Ingmar is present as bidders compete for the property that bears his family's name. The loss of the farm cuts deep, and the day marks a painful turning point in his life.
15.modern-da: Ved gårdens auktion er Ingmar til stede mens bydere konkurrerer om den ejendom der bærer hans families navn. Tabet af gården skærer dybt, og dagen markerer et smertefuldt vendepunkt i hans liv.

16.modern-en: On the morning of her departure for Jerusalem, Gertrude meets Ingmar and presses her inheritance money into his hands so he can buy back the farm. Their farewell is a marriage in spirit — a sacrifice and a promise bound together.
16.modern-da: Om morgenen inden hendes afrejse til Jerusalem møder Gertrude Ingmar og presser sine arvepenge i hans hænder så han kan købe gården tilbage. Deres farvel er et ægteskab i ånden — et offer og et løfte bundet sammen.

17.modern-en: Ingmar stands at the farm as the pilgrims gather to depart. He watches the procession of Hellgumists leave Dalecarlia, feeling both the weight of what he has kept and the grief of what he has lost.
17.modern-da: Ingmar står på gården mens pilgrimme samler sig for at rejse. Han ser Hellgumisternes procession forlade Dalarna og mærker både vægten af det han har beholdt og sorgen over det han har mistet.

18.modern-en: With Gertrude gone to Jerusalem and the farm in his hands, Ingmar must now build the future alone. The novel closes with him carrying both the land and the memory of her sacrifice.
18.modern-da: Med Gertrude rejst til Jerusalem og gården i hans hænder må Ingmar nu bygge fremtiden alene. Romanen slutter med ham bærende både jorden og mindet om hendes offer.

epithet.en: Ingmar's sister, follower of Hellgum's revival
epithet.da: Ingmars søster, tilhænger af Hellgums vækkelse

3.modern-en: Karin appears briefly as a child at the Ingmar farm following her father Big Ingmar's death. The responsibility of the household is already beginning to fall upon her young shoulders.
3.modern-da: Karin optræder kort som barn på Ingmar-gården efter sin fars Stor-Ingmars død. Ansvaret for husholdet begynder allerede at falde på hendes unge skuldre.

4.modern-en: As the eldest daughter, Karin takes over management of the Ingmar farm after her father's death. Her marriage to Elof is troubled and loveless, but she runs the farm with steady competence.
4.modern-da: Som ældste datter overtager Karin ledelsen af Ingmar-gården efter sin fars død. Hendes ægteskab med Elof er besværligt og kærlighedsløst, men hun driver gården med stødig kompetence.

7.modern-en: Karin is healed of a long illness through Hellgum's intercession and becomes a devoted follower of his revival movement. Her spiritual transformation is sudden and total, reshaping the entire household.
7.modern-da: Karin helbredes fra en langvarig sygdom ved Hellgums forbøn og bliver en hengiven tilhænger af hans vækkelsebevægelse. Hendes åndelige forvandling er pludselig og fuldstændig og omformer hele husholdet.

8.modern-en: After Ingmar saves Hellgum from the attack, Karin nurses her wounded kinsman back to health. She assures the pastor that Hellgum will cause no more trouble, trying to protect the peace of the farm.
8.modern-da: Efter Ingmar redder Hellgum fra angrebet plejer Karin sin sårede slægtning tilbage til helbred. Hun forsikrer præsten om at Hellgum ikke vil volde mere besvær og forsøger at beskytte gårdens fred.

11.modern-en: Karin receives a letter from Hellgum in Chicago declaring that God has called the congregation to Jerusalem. She announces the call to her fellow Hellgumists, and the decision to sell the farm and emigrate is set in motion.
11.modern-da: Karin modtager et brev fra Hellgum i Chicago hvori han erklærer at Gud har kaldet menigheden til Jerusalem. Hun bekendtgør kaldet for sine medtroende, og beslutningen om at sælge gården og emigrere sættes i gang.

13.modern-en: Karin arranges for the farm to be sold and welcomes the pastor when he comes to investigate. She is warm and hospitable even as the household prepares to dissolve, her faith unwavering.
13.modern-da: Karin arrangerer salget af gården og byder præsten velkommen når han kommer for at undersøge sagen. Hun er varm og gæstfri selv mens husholdet forbereder sig på at opløses, og hendes tro vakler ikke.

15.modern-en: At the auction, Karin accepts the final bid for the Ingmar farm with quiet dignity. The centuries-old property changes hands, and Karin stands ready to leave the world she has always known.
15.modern-da: Ved auktionen accepterer Karin det endelige bud på Ingmar-gården med stille værdighed. Den århundredgamle ejendom skifter hænder, og Karin er parat til at forlade den verden hun altid har kendt.

17.modern-en: Karin helps organize the departure of the pilgrims from Dalecarlia. She is among the leaders of the group setting out for the Holy Land, carrying the faith of an entire community on her shoulders.
17.modern-da: Karin hjælper med at organisere pilgrimmes afrejse fra Dalarna. Hun er blandt lederne af gruppen der drager mod Det Hellige Land og bærer en hel menigheds tro på sine skuldre.

18.modern-en: Karin departs for Jerusalem with the Hellgumist community, leaving the Dalecarlian village behind. The pilgrimage represents the fulfillment of a divine calling she has given everything to answer.
18.modern-da: Karin rejser mod Jerusalem med Hellgumist-samfundet og efterlader den dalarnske landsby bag sig. Pilgrimsrejsen repræsenterer opfyldelsen af et guddommeligt kald hun har givet alt for at efterkomme.

epithet.en: American preacher who leads the Jerusalem pilgrimage

7.modern-en: Hellgum arrives in the Dalecarlian village as a returning emigrant, a former blacksmith transformed by his years in Chicago. He saves Brita from suicide, heals Karin of her illness, and quickly gathers a devoted congregation at the Ingmar farm.
7.modern-da: Hellgum ankommer til den dalarnske landsby som en hjemvendt emigrant, en tidligere smed forvandlet af sine år i Chicago. Han redder Brita fra selvmord, helbreder Karin for hendes sygdom og samler hurtigt en hengiven menighed på Ingmar-gården.

8.modern-en: Three men ambush Hellgum on the road in retaliation for the disruption his preaching has caused. Ingmar intervenes and saves him, and afterward Hellgum's hold over the Hellgumists grows even stronger.
8.modern-da: Tre mænd overfalder Hellgum på vejen som gengæld for den uro hans prædiken har skabt. Ingmar griber ind og redder ham, og bagefter bliver Hellgums greb om Hellgumisterne endnu stærkere.

11.modern-en: A letter arrives from Hellgum in Chicago announcing that God has called the congregation to journey to Jerusalem. His voice, arriving from across the ocean, sets the entire community on the path toward the Holy Land.
11.modern-da: Et brev ankommer fra Hellgum i Chicago med meddelelse om at Gud har kaldet menigheden til at rejse til Jerusalem. Hans stemme, der ankommer fra den anden side af havet, sætter hele samfundet på vej mod Det Hellige Land.

17.modern-en: Hellgum leads the assembled Hellgumists out of Dalecarlia at the head of the pilgrim procession. His charismatic authority over the group is absolute as they set out on their journey to the Holy Land.
17.modern-da: Hellgum leder de forsamlede Hellgumister ud af Dalarna i spidsen for pilgrimstoget. Hans karismatiske autoritet over gruppen er absolut når de drager af sted på deres rejse til Det Hellige Land.

18.modern-en: Hellgum departs with the congregation for Jerusalem, the culmination of his mission to lead his people to the Holy City. The village watches as he leads the Dalecarlians into an uncertain but faith-driven future.
18.modern-da: Hellgum rejser med menigheden mod Jerusalem, kulminationen af hans mission om at lede sit folk til den hellige by. Landsbyen ser til mens han leder dalarnerne ind i en usikker men trosdrevet fremtid.

2.modern-en: Gertrude is introduced at age twelve, a dreamy child who builds a miniature Jerusalem out of twigs and stones in her garden. She makes a quiet, prophetic remark about the Holy City that those around her dismiss but which foreshadows the novel's central movement.
2.modern-da: Gertrude introduceres som tolvårig, et drømmende barn der bygger et miniature-Jerusalem af kviste og sten i sin have. Hun kommer med en stille, profetisk bemærkning om den hellige by som dem omkring hende afviser men som varsler romanens centrale bevægelse.

4.modern-en: Gertrude grows up at Storm's school alongside young Ingmar, developing a quiet fondness for him. She is a thoughtful, imaginative girl who sees the world with unusual depth for her age.
4.modern-da: Gertrude vokser op på Storms skole side om side med den unge Ingmar og udvikler en stille hengivenhed for ham. Hun er en eftertænksom, fantasifuld pige der ser verden med usædvanlig dybde for sin alder.

5.modern-en: Gertrude continues her life at Storm's mission school, shaped by his teaching and his quiet faith. Her bond with Ingmar deepens through shared days and small, meaningful exchanges.
5.modern-da: Gertrude fortsætter sit liv på Storms missionsskole, formet af hans undervisning og stille tro. Hendes bånd til Ingmar styrkes gennem fælles dage og små, meningsfulde udvekslinger.

6.modern-en: During the Wild Hunt dance, Gertrude clings to Ingmar as the revelry grows frenzied around them. The moment crystallizes her love for him, even if she cannot yet name it or act on it.
6.modern-da: Under Vilde Jagt-dansen klamrer Gertrude sig til Ingmar mens festligholderne vokser vilde omkring dem. Øjeblikket krystalliserer hendes kærlighed til ham, selv om hun endnu ikke kan navngive den eller handle på den.

7.modern-en: Gertrude is drawn toward the Hellgumist revival but hesitates. She is on the verge of joining the movement when events at the Ingmar farm bring her to Ingmar's side instead.
7.modern-da: Gertrude tiltrækkes af Hellgumist-vækkelsen men tøver. Hun er på nippet til at slutte sig til bevægelsen når begivenheder på Ingmar-gården i stedet bringer hende til Ingmars side.

8.modern-en: Sitting by the wounded Ingmar's bedside, Gertrude finally confesses her love for him. The confession costs her everything in terms of pride, and her vulnerability in that moment defines her character.
8.modern-da: Siddende ved den sårede Ingmars seng bekender Gertrude endelig sin kærlighed til ham. Bekendelsen koster hende alt hvad stoltheden angår, og hendes sårbarhed i det øjeblik definerer hendes karakter.

11.modern-en: The engagement between Gertrude and Ingmar is announced, a moment of joy surrounded by the growing storm of the Hellgumists' plans for Jerusalem. Gertrude begins to feel the pull of the holy calling alongside her love for Ingmar.
11.modern-da: Forlovelsen mellem Gertrude og Ingmar bekendtgøres, et øjeblik af glæde omgivet af den voksende storm om Hellgumisternes planer for Jerusalem. Gertrude begynder at mærke trækket af det hellige kald sideløbende med sin kærlighed til Ingmar.

12.modern-en: During the engagement, Gertrude spends precious days with Ingmar while wrestling privately with the voice that calls her toward Jerusalem. The conflict between earthly love and spiritual duty grows unresolvable.
12.modern-da: Under forlovelsestiden tilbringer Gertrude dyrebare dage med Ingmar mens hun privat kæmper med stemmen der kalder hende mod Jerusalem. Konflikten mellem jordisk kærlighed og åndelig pligt vokser uforsonlig.

16.modern-en: On her last morning in the village, Gertrude has a vision of Christ that resolves her inner conflict. She seeks out Ingmar and gives him her inheritance so he can buy back the farm, then departs — a farewell that functions as both wedding and sacrifice.
16.modern-da: På sin sidste morgen i landsbyen har Gertrude et syn af Kristus der løser hendes indre konflikt. Hun opsøger Ingmar og giver ham sin arv så han kan købe gården tilbage, og rejser derefter — et farvel der fungerer som både bryllup og offer.

17.modern-en: Gertrude joins the pilgrim procession departing Dalecarlia for the Holy Land. She walks away from everything she has known and loved, sustained only by faith and the vision that called her.
17.modern-da: Gertrude slutter sig til pilgrimstoget der forlader Dalarna for Det Hellige Land. Hun går bort fra alt hun har kendt og elsket, båret kun af tro og det syn der kaldte hende.

18.modern-en: Gertrude leaves for Jerusalem with the Hellgumist community, the sacrifice complete. She carries the love she has given up alongside the faith that demanded it, walking into an uncertain future.
18.modern-da: Gertrude rejser mod Jerusalem med Hellgumist-samfundet, offeret fuldbragt. Hun bærer den kærlighed hun har givet afkald på sideløbende med den tro der krævede det og går ind i en usikker fremtid.

epithet.en: The village schoolmaster, spiritual anchor of the community

2.modern-en: Storm is introduced as the village schoolmaster who has built a modest mission house at his own expense. He is described as a large, gentle man with a deep voice, respected for his steady faith and quiet labor.
2.modern-da: Storm introduceres som landsbyens skolemester der på egen bekostning har bygget et beskedent missionshus. Han beskrives som en stor, blid mand med dyb stemme, respekteret for sin standhaftige tro og stille arbejde.

3.modern-en: Storm hears from the pastor about the death of Big Ingmar. The news affects him deeply, as Ingmar was a pillar of the community Storm has spent his life serving.
3.modern-da: Storm hører fra præsten om Stor-Ingmars død. Nyheden påvirker ham dybt, da Ingmar var en søjle i det samfund Storm har brugt sit liv på at tjene.

4.modern-en: Storm takes in young Ingmar after his father's death and raises him alongside his own charges at the school. He becomes a surrogate father figure, quietly shaping the boy who will one day reclaim his family's farm.
4.modern-da: Storm tager den unge Ingmar ind efter hans fars død og opdrager ham sammen med sine egne elever på skolen. Han bliver en surrogatfadersskikkelse og former stille den dreng der en dag vil generobre sin families gård.

5.modern-en: Storm preaches at the Zion meeting house but faces a congregation that grows restless under his leadership. When the assembly revolts and demands he surrender the key to the church, he does so without bitterness.
5.modern-da: Storm prædiker i Zion-missionshuset men møder en menighed der bliver urolig under hans lederskab. Når forsamlingen gør oprør og kræver at han overdrager nøglen til kirken, gør han det uden bitterhed.

6.modern-en: Some of the children at Storm's school try to convert him to their new enthusiasm, inspired by the Hellgumist revival. Hellgum himself steps in and stops them from pressuring the old schoolmaster.
6.modern-da: Nogle af børnene på Storms skole forsøger at omvende ham til deres nye begejstring, inspireret af Hellgumist-vækkelsen. Hellgum selv griber ind og forhindrer dem i at presse den gamle skolemester.

15.modern-en: While the auction of the Ingmar farm unfolds nearby, Storm continues teaching his pupils the story of Nineveh. His steady presence amid the upheaval is a contrast to the chaos the Hellgumists have unleashed.
15.modern-da: Mens auktionen over Ingmar-gården udspiller sig i nærheden, fortsætter Storm med at undervise sine elever i historien om Nineve. Hans standhaftige tilstedeværelse midt i omvæltningerne er en kontrast til det kaos Hellgumisterne har udløst.

16.modern-en: As Gertrude prepares to depart for Jerusalem, she worries about leaving old Storm behind. He has grown frail, and the village he has served so long is being emptied of those he loves.
16.modern-da: Mens Gertrude forbereder sig på at rejse til Jerusalem, bekymrer hun sig over at efterlade den gamle Storm. Han er blevet skrøbelig, og den landsby han så længe har tjent tømmes for dem han elsker.

17.modern-en: Storm stands in the village as the pilgrims depart, a steadfast figure watching his world change irrevocably. He remains behind as the community he helped build walks away toward the Holy Land.
17.modern-da: Storm står i landsbyen mens pilgrimme rejser, en standhaftig skikkelse der ser sin verden forandre sig uigenkaldeligt. Han bliver tilbage mens det samfund han var med til at bygge går bort mod Det Hellige Land.
